title: Long deck 300 odp 001
notes: 300-slide pagination stress, odp counterpart of long-deck-300 pptx: 300 draw:page elements (10in x 7.5in, master-page mp1), each with a presentation:title frame (named style dp1) holding the exact line "Slide {i}" and a presentation:body frame (named style gp1) holding three bullets from the fixed 12-phrase NATO cycle (_LD_PHRASES imported from the pptx builder — imported, not re-spelled), so the phrase cycle is index-aligned with the pptx deck. Slide geometry is constant (dp1/gp1 slots); slide count is the only variable. Bullets are stored as plain text:p — no bullet glyph is in the file, bullet markers are renderer/style territory, and LibreOffice was not run here. reference_text is the exact title+bullets of every slide in order (1200 lines). The normative counters read draw:frame=600; the raw ~240 KB content.xml is carried uncompressed in the normalized STORED container (cross-env byte determinism, INV-4): saved blob is 211746 bytes, far under the 12 MB cap; generation (build+asserts) is asserted < 60 s at build time (no clock value recorded here — machine-dependent).
